run_health_check: run a health check against an HTTP/2 gRPC server on localhost:8080
run_health_check_custom_host: run a health check against an HTTP/2 gRPC server on a custom host and port
run_health_check_verify_encoding: run a health check that verifies the grpc-encoding header is present in the response
test_http2_connection: test an HTTP/2 connection to a gRPC server using hyper.HTTP20Connection
test_grpc_server_liveness: test that a gRPC server is live before running tests by checking its UnaryCall endpoint
